# Death Hag Kheitalla

*Page PDF 123*

Patrons and nemeses 

## **Death Hag Kheitalla**
_’You must see this as a holy transformation, my hated kinsman. Your insignificant lifeblood will flow from your body into something far greater, mingling with that of your Cothiqui brothers to sustain our bloody-handed master, Khaine of the Thousand Faces.’_ 

— Death Hag Kheitalla, sacrificing the crew of a captured hawkship 

**Motivation:** Extend her life through continuous murder **Short-term ambition:** Keep the Cauldron of Blood filled **Long-term ambition:** Turn the whole black ark into a floating temple of Khaine 

Kheitalla Heartspill is leader of the Knives of Khaine, the murder god’s most faithful followers on _Temple of Spite_ . Despite being ancient, she appears youthful thanks to the rejuvenating power of bathing in lifeblood each year. Kheitalla only shows her age when she smiles — each time she invigorates herself with the blood of sacrifices, her maddened grin becomes further carved in lines on her face. 

## **Kheitalla as Patron**
The death hag has simple desires, and loves nothing more than the divine act of murder. If she sees killing intent in the eyes of the Characters, she may offer her blessing, providing they display an unflinching commitment to slay their foes. Dwarf Slayers and warriors of all types may be surprised to find her treat them with respect — anyone may pay homage to Khaine, regardless of species. 

You do not live for thousands of years by murdering _everyone_ you meet, and Kheitalla has learned how to goad others into killing on her behalf. She may recruit a group of escaped captives to kill a dark elf enemy on the ark — the Khainites will not be implicated, blood will flow, and her problem disappears. In exchange, she could spare the Characters’ lives or provide knowledge of the ark in the hope they turn to his worship and kill on her behalf again. 

Kheitalla will (temporarily) stay the cult’s murderous hands for any enemy of Slaanesh. Scourging the Dark Prince’s followers is one of her callings, a step on the road to making the ark a Khainite haven. Characters striving to uncover or work against Nzandra or the Cult of Slaanesh might receive her counsel and patronage. 

Kheitalla is the voice of Khaine on the ark and speaks on his behalf at the Black Convocation and during religious ceremonies. Duriath Helbane holds her responsible for the conduct of her cultists, the most disruptive and adversarial faction on board, but Kheitalla has no interest in chastising her followers, and does the bare minimum to placate the fleetmaster. On occasions where an over-enthusiastic Khainite endangers the cult by murdering the wrong dark elf, she delivers the ultimate sanction and ultimate blessing with little fanfare. 

Kheitalla spends her days in direct service to Khaine, conducting prolonged (often public) sacrifices, passing judgement on those brave enough to seek the murder god’s counsel, and plotting heinous acts of violence. Most importantly, she tends the Cauldron of Blood in the temple, critical for the rites of Khaine, her own rejuvenation, and preparing witchbrew for the brides of Khaine. Should the boiling blood run too low, Kheitalla will order wholesale slaughter on the ark. 

Before Kheitalla joined the ark, her predecessor Thakara led an attempt to overthrow Helbane on a direct, but clandestine, order from Crone Hellebron. The Blood Queen of Har Ganeth determined that _Temple of Spite_ shall become wholly dedicated to Khaine — a floating slaughterhouse devoted to continual murder. Death Hag Thakara was instructed to eradicate Anethra Helbane’s influence from the ark and so undermine Morathi’s hold on power. Kheitalla has now received the same order and faces pressure from Har Ganeth to bring the plan to fruition.
